models.billing: Free models cost nothing and are marked {free} in the picker. Premium models are charged in Credits per second of generation, at a rate that depends on the thinking level: high is the cheapest per second because the model works longer but at a lower rate. The balance shown on the overview page is the account allowance reported by DeepAI.
